name: Premium · bag on a white cloud
summary: Big-brand calm: the bag small and alone on a vast white quilted cushion, overcast soft light, slow overhead descent, lots of negative space; price + COD rail added in the edit.
why_it_wins: Polène's Felted Edition makes a small bag precious through scale and silence: one hard, defined object in a soft, matte, empty world. Glossy or dark SIRINE bags pop hardest on matte white.

refs.note: never the Polène bag, logo or models

beats.scene: A vast pillowy white quilted cushion with deep tufted dimples and small cream buttons filling the frame, soft even overcast daylight from above
beats.composition: an empty dimple in the centre of the cushion where an object will be placed later

beats.motion: The product stays still; a soft highlight slides across its surface as the camera moves

copy.primary_structure: One quiet line about the look, then price, COD, delivery. No exclamation marks.

audio.notes: Soft piano/ambient bed; nothing on the cuts.

dos: Product occupies about a third of the frame
donts: No brand-like monograms on the set
